goal: Future read-only My Tracker/My Shares snapshots from supplied generated original-format bytes, without initializing original managers, scanning payloads or activating tracker/sharing/network services.

tracker_schema.root: Dictionary; torrents is a list of dictionaries. Missing torrents returns without activation in TRHostConfigImpl.loadConfig.

entry_fields.hash: Binary torrent hash from torrent.getHash; raw bytes preserved. Native display validation policy is separate from unchecked Java cast.
entry_fields.persistent: Optional Long: missing or exactly1 means true; all other values false.
entry_fields.passive: Optional Long: exactly1 true; missing/other false.
entry_fields.dateadded: Optional Long milliseconds. Original missing-value path reads current wall clock; read-only cached view should expose absent/unknown rather than silently inventing an original date.
entry_fields.status: Required Long for persistent load; Java intValue low32. Constants Failed0, Stopped1, Started2, Published3. Failed is normalized to Stopped during SERVICE RECOVERY, not by rewriting serialized data.
entry_fields.torrent_file: Optional byte path for passive torrent fallback; Constants.BYTE_ENCODING_CHARSET is ISO-8859-1. It is inert untrusted text for a snapshot, never permission to open that pathname.
entry_fields.stats: Optional dictionary: completed/announces/uploaded/downloaded required if stats exists; scrapes/bytesin/bytesout optional. All Long cumulative saved counters. Original recovery defaults missing optional counters0.
entry_fields.backup_time: Optional Long milliseconds inserted for retained nonactive statistics, bounded by original7day retention during save.

tracker_schema.classification: persistent=false records are saved-stat backups retained for a later host, not activated hosted torrents. Preserve/document them separately; do not blindly materialize all list records as current My Tracker rows.
tracker_schema.missing_live_fields: Config does not carry ordinary torrent name/category/announce URL, external flag, live seeds/peers/badNAT, interval averages or current service health. Optional metadata joins must use explicit supplied known snapshots, never path chasing or fake healthy values.
tracker_schema.load_hazards: loadConfig calls finder.lookupTorrent, may read passive torrent_file, host.addTorrent/addExternalTorrent, recover stats and consult public-tracker configuration. TRHostImpl constructor starts stats thread and may create servers; forbidden for isolated reading.
tracker_schema.failure_boundary: loadConfig catches Exception around whole traversal; prior activations can survive a later bad entry. Native per-entry diagnostic parsing is a deliberate snapshot policy, not exact full manager/admission/partial-commit equivalence.

shares_schema.root: Dictionary; resources is a list of resource dictionaries. Serialization rebuilds it from manager.getShares; do not assume source HashMap iteration is stable canonical ordering.

common_fields.type: Long intValue; ST_FILE1, ST_DIR2, ST_DIR_CONTENTS3. Original manager dispatches every non1/non2 to DirContents constructor; a native unknown-type diagnostic must be explicit instead of silently changing that behavior.
common_fields.file: UTF-8 bytes for resource file/root path. getName returns the full stored path, not basename. Keep path inert; no exists/canonicalFile/listFiles/stat/open.
common_fields.attributes: Dictionary of TorrentAttribute name→UTF-8 byte value, including Category. Original resolves known attribute objects and catches individual failures; snapshot preserves unknown raw entries without loading TorrentManager.
common_fields.props: Optional dictionary/string properties. persistent equalsIgnoreCase("true"); missing means false. tags is comma-separated long UID list, not display names; networks/personal/user_data are other named properties. Preserve unrecognized typed values without coercion.
common_fields.per_key: Optional personal byte key. Sensitive opaque data: retain only with owning source document as required, never display/log/export actual user values or interpret as infohash.

file_and_directory_fields.ihash: Fingerprint of filesystem metadata calculated by original BrokenMd5Hasher/getFingerPrintSupport, NOT torrent infohash. Do not use to join downloads or derive tracker identity.
file_and_directory_fields.ifile: UTF-8 relative torrent cache location, e.g. cacheN/<generated-number>.torrent, resolved by original manager under profile/shares. No original-style resolution/open is required for initial snapshot.

directory_contents_fields.cache_fields: No ShareItem ihash/ifile is serialized for directory-contents itself. Children are populated during later consistency scanning; do not synthesize children from path text.

shares_schema.unknown_columns: DateItem uses actual cached torrent creationDate(seconds)*1000 only for ShareResourceFile, else0; no top-level share creation timestamp. Show unknown without supplied cached metadata. Tags require UID→tag-name lookup outside this schema; preserve IDs instead of inventing names.
shares_schema.load_hazards: ShareManager.initialise creates profile/shares, adds listeners, loads cached torrents, resumes saving/readAZConfig, then starts initial scan thread. deserialiseResource may delete an earlier duplicate resource/cache; directory-contents constructor probes filesystem. getTorrent lazily reads shares/<ifile>. None is a pure parser.
shares_schema.identity_and_duplicates: Original map uses resource.getName path string; duplicate recovered names may delete/replace prior resource with side effects. Retain list index + source generation as snapshot identity and report duplicates; do not emulate deletion or collapse silently.

file_reader_boundary.original: FileUtil.readResilientConfigFile depends on SystemProperties user path, backup setting, recovery mode and possibly .saving/.bak. Backup recovery can rewrite primary; failures can create diagnostic/copy artifacts. It must not be called for a read-only seam.
file_reader_boundary.candidate: Reuse current ProfileLease and ConfigFile::load for exact allowlisted filenames tracker.config/sharing.config, or an equivalent directory-fd read. It accepts only complete bounded documents, reports Primary/Backup/Saving and never saves. Missing/invalid/unsupported are separate from a verified empty list.
file_reader_boundary.ownership: Return an owned immutable document plus typed optional row projection/diagnostics; no string_view may outlive the owning backing. Unknown fields and raw original bytes remain intact without any serialization/save API in this snapshot adapter.
file_reader_boundary.limits_proposal: Begin with existing core::Limits defaults: input/string4MiB,100000nodes,depth64; add a reviewed per-list row and cumulative displayed-text cap before allocating projections. Exact row/text caps must be frozen during implementation, not silently accepted as original format constraints. No enlarged limit/fallback allocator to fit malformed input.
file_reader_boundary.encoding: UTF-8 normal share paths/attributes/ifile; ISO-8859-1 tracker torrent_file. Preserve raw binary and decoding failure/unsupported text instead of treating every byte field as UTF-8. Date units differ; no implicit clock reads.

viable_followups: Separate pure projection codecs for original tracker.config and sharing.config, consumed by existing background profile-lease owner; no root manager dependencies.

First useful My Tracker snapshot exposes saved hash/status/passive/persistent/date/cumulative counters, clearly labelled persisted/offline; names/URLs/health unknown unless explicit safe metadata supplied.
First useful My Shares snapshot exposes persisted full name/path, type/recursive, Category and persistent flag; raw tag UIDs optional, cache dates/infohash unknown. No scan/cache dereference.

Generated fixtures must be self-contained public data in new private roots and exercise original-format bytes; no fabricated live service records or reuse of the normal profile. Native parser tests initially have no source-runtime/equality credit.

If original Java observation becomes necessary, freeze an inert field/serialization seam first. Do not instantiate config/manager/resource constructors or FileUtil recovery. Callback/load/save/fault effects remain separate source-only scope.
required_cases_before_implementation_com: Absent file vs valid empty list vs malformed root/list
All tracker booleans/defaults/status low32/unknown and retained backup rows
All3 share resource types and missing mandatory/optional fields
Binary/invalid encoding/Unicode, unknown dictionaries and exact unchanged source bytes
Duplicate hash/path records retained/diagnosed without deletion
Traversal/absolute/embedded-NUL/ifile/per_key data remains inert; no file/stat/network API invoked
Row/string/node/depth budget edges, cancellation, stale generation, repeated refresh and page teardown
Primary/backup/saving source reported with no recovery write or .saving cleanup
non_claims: No live profile, filesystem scan, tracker server, share publisher, directory creation outside evidence
No unknown-data writer/serialization compatibility or complete manager restoration
